For a timing relationship, state the delegate's preference and the actual timing and force of the adopted text. Keep the speaker's own stance separate from what the Council adopted. Do not infer endorsement, agreement or legal authority from a shared topic. Return exactly NONE when there is no specific supported link. Use only the two fields below. Return only the comparison.
